title: PromiseBroken.v1
description: Payload of the PromiseBroken event (A§23). Emitted by arrangement-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — when a promise passes its due date without being satisfied by an allocated payment, detected by the deterministic `tick breach-check --as-of=<date>` job rather than by wall-clock timers (SVC-5, A§10.2 ACCEPTED -> BROKEN). Published on `collections.arrangement` keyed by `promiseId` (A§23), so it is ordered behind the PromiseCreated it invalidates. case-service appends a case activity and re-prioritises on it, and broken-promise counts in the last 90 days are a decisioning context input (A§52). Carries the same fields as PromiseCreated so that a consumer can act on the breach without holding the creation. Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as PromiseBroken.v2 (D§29).

promiseId.description: Platform identifier of the broken promise. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§23).

caseId.description: Platform identifier of the case the promise was made on, so case-service can append the activity and set `next_action_at` without a lookup.

accountId.description: Platform identifier of the account the promise was for.

amountMinor.description: Amount that was promised and not paid, in minor units of `currency` — the originally promised amount, unchanged by any partial payment (partial settlement is visible through PaymentAllocated, and keeping this value stable makes the promise-kept rate computable from these events alone). Strictly positive.

currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 currency of `amountMinor`; always the account's currency.

dueDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the promise was due, i.e. the date the breach check found to be in the past. Always strictly before the `--as-of` business date of the tick that raised this event.
